Title: Fangs for the Watch
Details: The Bloodfang pack has been bold, $N. Bold enough that the Watch no longer believes my reports.$B$BBring me proof: fangs, pulled from the Bloodfang Stalkers on the western ridge. Six should silence the doubters. Take them to Sergeant Blackwald - he will know what they mean.
Objectives: Collect 6 Large Fangs from Bloodfang Stalkers and bring them to Sergeant Morris Blackwald in Duskhaven.
RequestText: Lorna sent you? Then you have something for me.
CompleteText: By the Light... these are no wolf's teeth. Lorna was right, and I owe her an apology. Take this, $C - the Watch pays its debts.
